entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item. Order number is VF544-901B.
Certainly. Let me just pull that up... VF544-901B. I see the order is for the Aero-Pro helmet. To get started, is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference. The color isn't what I expected. It's just been sitting here.

I can understand that. Getting the right color for your gear is important, especially for a helmet where visibility contributes to safety. Can you confirm if the item is still in its original packaging?
Yes, the box is unopened. Never even took it out.

Thank you for confirming. I'm checking the delivery date here, and I see it arrived 50 days ago. Let me just review the policy for you... Okay, you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window for standard items.
I can go ahead and approve this return right away. I am generating a pre-paid return label and sending it to the email we have on file. You should receive it in the next few minutes.
Whatever. Just make sure it actually gets sent.
The email has just been sent. Once we receive the helmet back at our warehouse, you'll receive a full refund. Was there anything else I could assist you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
